verses.gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਫੁਲਵਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhavarai vaas vinaas hai firadhaa fulavaaRee|

en.bdb: The black bee gets perished while enjoying the fragrance in the garden.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਅਖਿ ਉਘਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: jalai pata(n)g nisa(n)g hoi kar akh ughaaRee|

en.bdb: Moth fearlessly burns itself on the flame but goes on beholding in the face of the flame up to last.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਗ ਨਾਦਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਓਜਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: mirag naadh bisamaadh hoi firadhaa ojaaRee|

en.bdb: Overwhelmed by melody, the deer goes on wandering in the forests.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਡੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਛ ਜਿਉ ਰਸਿ ਜੀਭ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: ku(n)ddee faathe machh jiau ras jeebh vigaaRee|

en.bdb: Overpowered by the taste of tongue, the fish itself catches the hook.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥਣਿ ਹਾਥੀ ਫਾਹਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੈ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: haathan haathee faahiaa dhukh sahai dhihaaRee|

en.bdb: Out of lust for its female, the male elephant gets caught and bears sufferings for the rest of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa pirahaRee lai nij ghar taaRee ||3||

en.bdb: Likewise, the Sikhs of the Guru love their Guru and stablize themselves in their true selves.
